## Summary

Implemented rejection of identical-owner creation (HTTP 409) on `POST /api/owners`, following the OfficeFloor function-injection pattern.

**New files:**
- `EnsureOwnerUnique.java` (function) — reads the built `Owner`, queries `OwnerRepository.findByLastName(...)`, and throws `DuplicateOwnerException` if any existing owner matches on all five fields (firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone).
- `DuplicateOwnerException.java` — checked exception (extends `Exception`) so it surfaces in the `throws` clause for OfficeFloor escalation.
- `DuplicateOwnerExceptionHandler.java` — escalation handler responding `409 Conflict` with a `ProblemDetail` body (matching the existing handler style).
- `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.DuplicateOwnerException.yml` — wires the exception to its handler.

**Modified:**
- `owners.POST.yml` — inserted the `ensureUnique` step between `build` and `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`.
- `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests.createOwnerSuccess` — its payload was byte-identical to seed owner #1 (George Franklin, 110 W. Liberty St.), so under the new rule it now legitimately conflicts. Made the address unique so the test still verifies successful `201` creation without violating the new business rule.

The new `Cp01Tests` (409 on identical owner, 2xx on distinct owners) and all 255 existing tests pass.
